name: Path settings and turn gains
description: The S-curve with the path settings raised and the turn gains changed, then a half turn. Speed limit 90%, Acceleration 80 in/s² and Cornering 70 in/s² plan the path in 3.22 s, down from 3.62 s at the defaults of 70%, 60 and 60, and the step takes 4.07 s, down from 4.23 s, still ending 0.1 in off. Raising them to 100%, 100 and 80 plans 2.94 s, but the robot runs 11.5 in off the plan and the step takes 4.16 s and ends 0.8 in off, so more is not faster. Turn P 0.5 and D 3 end the half turn 0.6° off; the default 0.3 and 1.5 end it 1.3° off in the same time.
